notes: Provider is owner-authored, package license UNLICENSED; no external open-source base was selected. Extracted declarations/runtime snippets are authorized by the provider-following card; no new third-party runtime dependency.
schema.json is an exact copy, including original historical annotations and wider surfaces. This card covers POST events, DELETE withdrawal and GET contributions only.

events.js/errors.js are TypeScript-erased provider sources. validation.js extracts token/deviceId/timestamp. fixture-service.js extracts deviceActor/subject and those three methods, acceptedEvent and availability; identical checks/order with synthetic repository/executor injection.

eventDigest includes event nonce, unsigned optional attribution/receipt, excludes signature. Repository id conflict precedes cross-event nonce reuse, scoped per deployment/device. No provider acceptance rule changes.
Identity request replay is IDENTITY_DEVICE_REPLAY in C-IDENTITY and 401 USAGE_AUTH_REQUIRED on Usage wire; requests are re-signed while original event nonce remains.
Fixture is synthetic, has actual Ed25519 verification but no SQL, HTTP transport/security hooks, rollups, purge or caller-managed transactions. No REAL_DB/REAL_HOST/REAL_UI or owner ACCEPTED claim.
